title: On the integral algebraic K-theory of Morava K-theory
summary: We compute the cardinalities of the integral algebraic K-theory groups of connective Morava K-theory $k(n)$ in all degrees that are not congruent to $0$ or $1$ modulo $2p-2$. After base-changing the coefficients of $k(n)$ to the algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbb{F}}_p$, we determine the corresponding cardinalities in all degrees and show that the groups vanish in even degrees. Our approach uses what we call the orbit filtration on topological cyclic homology arising from the May filtration on topological Hochschild homology.
